Careers

Open Positions & Opportunities

The Weebit team is comprised of some of the industry’s smartest, most talented engineers and scientists. It’s this team, led by our world-renowned executives and board members, that is responsible for our continued progress toward delivering the industry’s most advanced memory technologies.

If you’re passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with a highly collaborative global team, Weebit wants to hear from you!

You are also welcome to send us your CV at Careers@weebit-nano.com

Failure Analysis Engineer

Israel, Hod HaSharon (Hybrid)

Drive fault isolation and root cause analysis of advanced semiconductor devices, with a focus on memory arrays and associated logic and peripheral circuitry.

View Position

Analog Design Engineer

Israel, Hod HaSharon (Hybrid)

Be part of the  team that is responsible for developing and optimizing the state-of-the-art analog circuits that power our embedded ReRAM and mixed-signal products.

View Position

Demand Generation & Digital Marketing Manager

USA, Remote

Lead the digital marketing and demand generation activities, drive digital visibility, audience engagement, pipeline growth through integrated campaigns, content activation, SEO/GEO, marketing automation, social media, and analytics.

France, Grenoble

An Analog Design Engineer with at least 5 years of experience to play a key role in the design and development of our advanced memory technology.
